title: Schema for the campaign hero side mission cards data file (red side missions)

id.description: Id for entry: a UUID (see docs/data-model.md).

hero_id.description: Foreign key to the hero in data/heroes.json the mission is for.

back_id.description: Foreign key to this card's back in data/card-backs.json.

image.description: The file path for this hero side mission's image.
